title: Probabilistic results for monoids of order-preserving transformations
summary: Let $\mathcal{PO}_n$ be the monoid of all order-preserving partial transformations on $X_n=\{1,\dots, n\}$ with the natural order, and let $\mathcal{O}_n$ and $\mathcal{POI}_n$ denote its submonoids of order-preserving full and injective partial transformations, respectively. For each transformation $α\in\mathcal{PO}_n$, write the random variables $Y(α)=|{\im}α|$ and $Y_r(α)=|{\im}α|$ given that $|{\dom}α|=r$ for $0 \leqslant r \leqslant n$. We determine the probability distribution, expectation and variance of $Y_r$ and $Y$ for $\mathcal{PO}_n$ and $\mathcal{POI}_n$. In particular, $Y_r(α)$…
